holiday-regated-onto-a-policy-code.why: Adding a public holiday is re-gated onto an SLA POLICY code, collapsing the distinction four-action Phase 4 drew: a holiday is clerical and factual, an SLA duration is a policy decision with regulatory weight, and an office must be able to grant one without the other. four-action-separability.e2e-spec.ts dies. NARROWED: the decorator alone now matches THREE sites, because the holiday module grew a fixed-dates route and an occasion route. The @Post line beneath it is what says which create this is.

refusal-names-the-removed-umbrella.why: The refusal names the umbrella that four-action Phase 4 SPLIT, instead of the read code whose absence actually caused the failure — sending the reader to ask for a grant that no longer exists. payment-channels.spec.ts dies on "(payment-channel.read)", and screen-copy.test.ts's "every code handed to the shared sentence names a permission that exists" dies too, because payment-channel.manage is not in the catalogue any more. REPLACES the two plants `refusal-still-names-the-removed-umbrella` and its `arabic-` twin, which anchored on the two halves of `pcNoPermission`. That key became `pcRefusalAct` and holds only the ACT; the code moved to the call site. So the English/Arabic split no longer exists to plant against — one sentence, one place, one plant, which is the refusal rework showing up in its own evidence.
